statement: The priority-recovery drain owned by the operation_workflow_owner does not stale-fail a locally-owned ledger self-move that is parked at the IDLE_ONLY census behind live incumbents: a PENDING self-move whose dispatch lane holds fresh waiting_for_incumbent or waiting_for_idle_ledger park evidence is progress, not staleness, so the drain settles it as recovering (an available local owner is woken, not killed — the same rule already applied to remote owners) and the self-move claims SENDING on the incumbent's terminal without a stale FAIL, re-plan, or successor. PENDING_TIMEOUT_MS and the stale rules for self-moves without park evidence, exclusion once engaged, IDLE_ONLY, terminal-only release, budgets and cadences, the 60-second certification window and the single cluster-ACTIVE authority are unchanged. Proven by the hold-fairness real-owner witness with a 35-second incumbent: red on HEAD (fail_priority_recovery_drain_stale on the parked local_owner self-move at age 30 s, then re-plan and a successor 15 s later), green after (no stale FAIL while park evidence is fresh; SENDING on the incumbent's terminal; a parked self-move with no park evidence for a full PENDING_TIMEOUT_MS still stale-fails). Root cause from GCP runs 2026-08-30T04-49-12 and 07-06-30 (REPLACE b0b98821 parked behind cpp learner ADDs, drain-failed stale at age 33.6/39.8 s while local_owner, costing 15 s of re-plan).

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The operation_workflow_owner (priority-recovery drain in operation-workflow-recovery-timeout.js / recovery-drain.js / reconcile-shared.js together with the dispatch gate park evidence) stays the sole owner of staleness and progress classification; planners, the harness and the readiness owner never re-derive it.

PENDING_TIMEOUT_MS and the stale-fail rules are unchanged for self-moves and other operations without fresh park/progress evidence; park evidence must be typed, time-bounded (fresh relative to the same clock the drain uses) and produced only by the dispatch gate of the owning node.
IDLE_ONLY, exclusion once engaged, terminal-only release, DISPATCH_RETRY_DELAY_MS, the 60-second GCP certification window and the failed-repair backoff are unchanged. No sleeps or timeout widening.
Prove through the hold-fairness real-owner witness fixture (virtual clock, run-cited latencies) red on HEAD and green after, before any GCP run.
Do not make the harness, analyzer, or readiness owner derive cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.
